description.value: Sfinaki Greek Taverna is a family-owned Greek restaurant operated by the Karamessinis family in The Heights neighbourhood of Burnaby for over 25 years. It has earned multiple 'Burnaby's Best' awards for Greek food, catering, and family dining. Touring cyclists can fuel up on gyros, souvlaki, moussaka, and fresh salads either dining in or ordering takeout for pickup.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 29m; stands (2 spaces) at 81m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address (4071 Hastings Street, Burnaby BC V5C 2J1) and phone (604-299-3400). The site confirms active dine-in, takeout, and catering operations. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. The OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the business is in Burnaby per both the website and postal code V5C 2J1.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'North Vancouver' but the business address is in Burnaby (V5C 2J1); the website consistently identifies it as Burnaby.

OSM opening_hours (Mo-Th 11:00-20:00; Fr-Sa 11:00-21:00) does not match website hours (Tue-Thu 11:30am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-10pm, closed Sun-Mon and holidays); website should be treated as authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, award-winning sit-down restaurant with takeout options on a major arterial road in Burnaby; a solid meal stop for touring cyclists on or near the Hastings corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email sfinaki@sfinaki.ca found on website contact page; not present in OSM tags.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: spanakopita, fasolada (white bean soup), village salad, greek salad, zucchini kefte, sfinaki dips (hummus, tzatziki, tarama), saganaki. No explicit GF or vegan labelling found

wow_evidence: family-owned... for over 25 years... multiple 'Burnaby's Best' awards
